text: Understanding databases is important for anyone working with data. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store information in tables, which are like organized lists with rows and columns. To get data from these tables, you use queries—special commands that ask the database questions. Good data modelling helps you plan how tables connect to each other, making your database efficient and easy to use. Indexes are another useful tool; they work like a book's index, helping the database find information quickly without searching every row. NoSQL databases, on the other hand, are more flexible and store data differently, which suits certain modern applications better.
